_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', with 'approximately 7,000 products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2009 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', with 'approximately 7,000 products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2009 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.32x; +10% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.39; conservative 2yr +23%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY08-FY08 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.6%/yr (Q1 FY10 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 66-trading-day ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.6%/yr (no FY08-FY08 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +14.6%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY08-FY08: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2010-02-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.32x (11.0% downside to Bear $15.31 / +34.4% upside to Bull $23.12) | Adj composite 2.54 vs market 2.93: gap -0.39 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +10% above the EPP floor $15.60 (60x FY10E $0.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: +22.6% total (+11.3%/yr) | At 66.2x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $22.75 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net revenue -4.3% YoY in Q4 FY09, forward revenues +12.8-16.3% (Q1 FY10 revenue guide (Q4 FY09 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
